To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
product differentiation can have both positive and negative effects, depending on the context.

1) product differentiation is not a bad practice, as it is usually considered, but it is an efficient way to increase market share and profits; 2) firms can use product differentiation to exploit market power; 3) newcomers can enter the horizontally differentiated market; 4) the market structure is not stable over time, but it evolves through the entrance and the exit of firms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the market structure in a horizontally differentiated market, and the entry process.
the study of the role of product differentiation in the market.
the role of product differentiation in a market, with the aim to find the real effects of this strategy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
product differentiation is a very important strategy in the market, and it is used by incumbent to gain market power.
product differentiation is a competitive strategy, which can be used to gain market shares and to avoid entry of competitors.
product differentiation is an anticompetitiv strategy, but it is a necessary condition to allow newcomers to enter a market.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the product differentiation is not an anticompettitive strategy, but it is a natural way to exploit market power and to defend the market.

we found a conciliation between two different approaches to product differentiation, we also showed that product differentiation is an effective way to deter entry in the market.

the max-min principle is a powerful tool to understand product differentiation.
